title: Margaret R Possible NDE 7383
content: All that I remember is that I was sitting in a room. It wasn't a room in that it had doors or windows. It was more like a section of a white marble structure. There were columns and archways. I was sitting on steps. I do not remember if I had any thoughts. I can not described what I looked like. I just remember sitting there and I had on a robe. I seemed rather small but that was in comparison to the archways behind me. There was darkness in that there did not seem to be any discernible source of light. It is hard to explain how it could be dark and there was light at the same time. This larger being pretty much just floating into the area where I was and told me "the Father is ready to hear your petition". I then followed this being. The next memory was floating in front of the Father to deliver my petition. The Father sat on an immense throne. I could not see His face; but, I could see his legs and arms. He was, is, pretty huge. I was floating in front on Him and I was very small in comparison, like the size of a fly to a human. While there was darkness around me and the elect, there was an intense light behind Him. On either side of the throne stood a large number of beings, who were also a great deal bigger than I, but not nearly the size of the Father. In my memory these were the "elect" or teachers. The Father spoke to me and asked me to begin. I explained that I wanted to help "Ramona" and why. I do not remember the details of why, just that she was a good person and could do great things with help. He then asked me about my training. At this time, three of the beings that were in the line came forward and stopped behind me. One of them (I have the impression that he was the leader or the one with more authority) moved forward more and said that I had been trained and had responded well to my training. I then began to describe the training that I had received and what I learned from it. As I explained it, I had a review of the training as if I was engaged in the activities. The only thing that I can remember is leaning how to walk and maintain a connection to the divine at the same time. I also remember that I learned to withhold making judgments, not just about a person, but also about any situation or circumstance that I found myself within. I was not to determine if it was bad or good. I was to first allow the Father to show me how to view it, or the person, and how to react and feel about it. This would be kind of fed or downloaded to me in the form of an impression. (I often get these in life). This way, whatever the experience, the Father is telling me what I need to know in order to perform or react and feel in the manner that best suits my survival here and my growth to be that which I was created to be. When I was done the Father told me that it what I wanted to undertake would be very hard (it has been) and that I may not remember (I don't remember what He said here) and that my "Friends" may not be able to help me, especially if I didn't remember. I responded by saying that I knew it would be hard but all I really needed to remember was how much I am loved, surrounded, and supported and in that to just "be". This is all I remember of the experience.

arrival.other_being_detail: A larger being 'floating' in and telling her, "the Father is ready to hear your petition"; later many beings by the throne identified as 'the elect' or teachers; 'Friends' mentioned.

environment.environment_other_detail: White marble structure with columns, archways, steps; darkness with no discernible light source yet 'light at the same time'; intense light behind the Father on a throne.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Petition to help "Ramona"; Father said what she wanted to undertake would be very hard and that she may not remember; mention that "Friends" may not be able to help if she didn't remember.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Petition to 'the Father'; 'training' review; beings identified as 'elect/teachers'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Begins already in a non-earthly marble/columned area; then escorted to the Father on a throne; includes a 'training' re-experiencing/review; no tunnel/OBE/boundary/return described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Describes a 'petition' audience with 'the Father' on a throne, with 'elect/teachers' present; a 'training' review focused on maintaining connection to the divine while walking and withholding judgment; information 'fed or downloaded' as impressions.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "the Father is ready to hear your petition"; "all I really needed to remember was how much I am loved, surrounded, and supported and in that to just 'be'."
